# Cultured Chicken Cost Model

> Interactive Monte Carlo model for estimating cultured chicken production costs, built for The Unjournal's Pivotal Questions work on cultivated meat cost trajectories.

By The Unjournal (https://unjournal.org), a nonprofit that commissions public expert evaluations of impactful research. Published evaluations: https://unjournal.pubpub.org. About: https://info.unjournal.org. Related workshop: https://uj-cm-workshop.netlify.app/. Source code: https://github.com/unjournal/cm_pq_modeling

## Pages

- [Cultured Chicken Production Cost Model (advanced)](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/): the full Monte Carlo model with adjustable inputs and a sensitivity (tornado) chart
- [Simplest Model](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/simple.html): a reduced version of the model with fewer inputs
- [How Cultured Chicken is Made](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/learn.html): background on the production process the model represents
- [TEA Comparison](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/compare.html): what published techno-economic analyses estimate, compared with the model
- [Cost to Demand](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/demand.html): bridging production costs to an adoption model
- [Model formulas & metrics](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/docs.html): equations, parameters and output definitions
- [Sensitivity analysis](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/sensitivity.html): what the tornado chart can and cannot tell you, with alternative estimators
- [Discussion Map](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/discuss.html): open questions and discussion links
- [Model Limits & Critique](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/limits.html): known limitations and critiques of the model
- [About](https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/about.html): project background and how to give feedback

Full page list: https://unjournal.github.io/cm_pq_modeling/sitemap.xml
